phase: Final catalog rerun after the clamped-destination/Stay fix and Japji completeness guard
navigation: Standard History API and popstate route transitions in the live app; the initial family files separately record full-page loads. The final run resumed from its saved 60-case checkpoint after the workspace disconnected. No app source changed between those final-run segments.
method: Wait for the expected normalized row count and bani identity, fonts and four animation frames. Operate actual Contents buttons to verify section counts, unique first/middle/last labels and targets, header clearance, exactly one correct current marker, Return restoration, document and Contents widths, and the native HTML scroller.
limitations: This is automated browser DOM/geometry validation. Representative screenshots were reviewed separately. It does not claim browser clicks on every one of the 2,411 targets or physical iPhone, Safari, installed PWA or Capacitor validation.
